content.title: How to watch MSU women's basketball vs. Colorado State in NCAA tourney
content.text: GREEN & WHITE BASKETBALLWhat channel is MSU women's basketball on? How to watch NCAA tourney opener Brian CallowayLansing State JournalMarch 20, 2026, 9:39 a.m. ET0:01/0:15Keep WatchingThe Michigan State women's basketball team has won 22 games in each of its three seasons so far under Robyn Fralick.The Spartans (22-8) will try to pass that total when they open the NCAA tournament against Colorado State at 7:30 p,m. Friday, March 20 at the University of Oklahoma. A win would give MSU its most victories in a season since going 25-9 in 2015-16.The matchup marks just the second all-time meeting between MSU and Colorado State. The Spartans beat Colorado State, 72-45, at the Caribbean Classic in Cancun, Mexico in Dec. 2011.Colorado State won the Mountain West tournament and played just one game against teams in the NCAA tourney field. The Rams recorded a 70-66 road win over Gonzaga on Nov. 13.More: Progress for MSU women's basketball sparked by Grace VanSlooten's belief in programNeed a news break?
